source.title: Open problems in nonlinear ordinary boundary value problems arising from the study of large-amplitude periodic oscillations in suspension bridges

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/879829 with trailing identifier 879829. Local shard metadata in outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-1.csv identifies the same source URL, year 1996, and title. The zbMATH page itself did not expose a readable record or full-text body in the browser fetch, and local shell fetching of zbmath.org and api.zbmath.org failed with DNS resolution errors.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted plus metadata_only, with network_or_dns_failure for local shell fetches. Exact-title recovery found the De Gruyter/Brill chapter DOI 10.1515/9783110883237.349 in World Congress of Nonlinear Analysts '92, pages 349-358, by A.C. Lazer and P.J. McKenna, but the chapter PDF endpoint reported restricted access and did not expose full text.

Bounded exact-work searches attempted the exact title, the exact title plus PDF and authors, and the DOI plus PDF. Candidate pages inspected or identified were the De Gruyter restricted chapter PDF, De Gruyter book/table-of-contents pages, the ResearchGate author-profile publication entry, the PagePlace preview PDF, and citing-paper reference lists. These candidates confirmed identity metadata only or were restricted; none contained a readable primary-source problem statement, so no candidate extraction was performed.
Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. No questions were extracted from metadata, abstracts, search snippets, title text, or related papers.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/879829.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
